content_fixes.old: "Then Jesus said, "God's kingdom is like this. A guy throws seed on a field, then goes to bed and totally forgets about it. The seed sprouts and grows—he has no idea how it happens. The ground does everything by itself: first a green stem pops up, then a bud, then ripe grain. When the grain is fully ready, he harvests. It's harvest time!""
